coordinator_decision.context: Close the committed no-run V6 evidence-boundary review after fresh independent theory, accounting, and red-team inspection.
rationale: All three independent reviewers issued REVISE for launch-plan design only; execution remains unauthorized.
Registered curve derivation occurs before row digest authentication and trusted resource reservation, so some rejected inputs consume work omitted from their phase receipts.
Late-invalid rows can enter replay and primary proof, while exception receipts can discard an already-passed reservation and completed partial work.
Blocking file open precedes regular-file validation, oversized files are not rejected from initial metadata, and FIFO admission is not total.
B-derived mask and exact-empty-frontier checks do not fail before expensive semantics, and diagnostic output lacks count and byte ceilings.
The focused suite constructed one generated canonical-scope density row despite the declared zero-family-row boundary.
The standalone B4 oracle does not directly compare complete candidate and eligible formal-point lists, and the verifier-source hash is not executed-code attestation.
limitations: No persisted V6 curve-family row, canonical matrix, runner, launch plan, or run authorization was created.
One focused control did construct a generated density row in memory; it is excluded from research evidence and must not be repeated under the zero-row boundary.
The V6 findings are verifier, accounting, and governance defects, not evidence against the coordinate-predicate hypothesis.
The fixed graph theorem, input-byte snapshot, exact types, legacy rejection, registered grid, frozen B4 semantic reconstruction, and gate arithmetic remain useful implementation evidence.
No relation generation, rank, target descent, preprocessing crossover, rho comparison, exponent, deployment, or ECDLP result is in scope.

Construct and receipt trusted combinatorial reservation before registered curve derivation; record actual curve draws and point enumerations.
Stop replay and proof after earlier errors, instrument phases at call sites, and preserve reservation plus partial work through exceptions.
Use nonblocking regular-file admission, reject oversized files from initial fstat, state parent-symlink policy, and cap diagnostic count and bytes.
Replace the generated density-row test with factor-base-only provenance controls and directly compare complete standalone candidate and eligible formal lists.
Treat the verifier self-hash as diagnostic only until a future immutable runner binds the executed commit.
Retain maximum_runs=0 and request fresh exact-commit review before launch-plan design.
